Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

explanations.C: Configure Macie automated discovery to continuously sample data from the S3 buckets. Perform full scans of the S3 buckets where Macie discovers sensitive data.
explanations.D: Configure Macie scans to run on the S3 buckets. Aggregate the results of the scans in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use the DynamoDB table for queries.
